system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a traded good. Rare, Salt. 1 item slot (Small, Quickdraw). Uses: 6.

A small metal contraption, filled with gears and mechanisms. It looks like it can be turned along one axis, opening small openings all over the sides. It’s letting out such a pretty light!

Widetock (Action): You set the Widetock to In or Out from its safety position.

Widetock (Out) (Action): (Prerequisite: Tock in the Out Position). You may throw the Widetock up to 30ft into a square. The Widetock explodes when it hits the ground. All creatures within 10ft of the Widetock make a Power Check (DC18) or are pushed 10ft away from the Widetock and knocked Prone.

Widetock (In) (Action): (Prerequisite: Tock in the In Position). You may throw the Widetock up to 30ft into a square. The Widetock explodes when it hits the ground. All creatures within 15ft of the Widetock make a Power Check (DC18) or are pulled 10ft towards the Widetock and knocked Prone.

Rulebook p.75.
